::: {#exm-posterior}
#### Posterior probability that a coin is biased

A coin is either fair ($\param = 0.5$)
or biased toward heads ($\param = 0.8$),
where $\param$ is its probability of heads,
with prior probabilities $\p(0.5) = 0.9$ and $\p(0.8) = 0.1$.
After three tosses that all land heads,
the posterior distribution of $\param$ is its conditional distribution given those tosses.
Its probabilities are computed in @exm-marginal-likelihood.
:::
